== Biography ==

''from Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0):''

Joshua Johnson is an American journalist. He is the former host of 1A, which is produced by WAMU and nationally distributed by NPR. In 2019, he joined MSNBC and hosted The Week with Joshua Johnson; he later hosted Now Tonight with Joshua Johnson on NBC News Now. Since 2024, he has appeared in videos for The Onion, a satire news organization.
